manual: Trajectory Analysis and Optimization System (TAOS) User's Manual, Version 96.0, December 1995
purpose: Self-contained, end-to-end grammar, semantic, application, analytic, and metamorphic test corpus.
runtime_boundary: Runtime tests require TAOS_EXE to point to a historical or compatible TAOS executable. The suite itself does not contain TAOS.
